title: 同花顺快查企业数据 MCP 配置
description: 请输入从同花顺快查数据平台获取的 API Key。凭证仅保存在您的本机，由 WorkBuddy 在连接同花顺快查 MCP 时注入请求头；WorkBuddy 云端不存储、不接收该凭证。
description_en: Enter the API Key obtained from the Kuaicha data platform. The credential is stored only on your device and injected into the request header when WorkBuddy connects to the Kuaicha MCP; the WorkBuddy cloud does not store or receive it.
